reviewNote: Drafted by Claude for faculty review from the Carson-Newman scenario. Not validated teaching content.
summary: Elective knee scope in a healthy young woman who ate a full breakfast at 0800, has a probable MH family history (uncle: fever and rigidity under GA), an unknown pregnancy status, and a difficult airway exam with a loose incisor. The CN teaching case: postpone the elective case; if it goes later, trigger free with a difficult airway plan.

asa.rationale: Healthy. The NPO violation does not change ASA physical status.

decision.rationale: Elective case with a full meal 2 hours ago; postpone (at least 8 hours after a fatty meal) and plan trigger free anesthesia when rescheduled.

redFlags.finding: Full meal 2 hours before an elective case
redFlags.evidence: Eggs, toast, sausage at 0800; orange juice at 0800.
redFlags.implication: Fails ASA fasting minimum (8 h after fatty food); aspiration risk.
redFlags.action: Postpone the elective case; notify the surgeon.

redFlags.evidence: Maternal uncle: high fever and rigidity under GA, ICU, family warned it may be inherited.
redFlags.action: Trigger free anesthetic (no volatiles, no succinylcholine), flushed machine with charcoal filters, dantrolene available, notify team, refer for testing.

redFlags.evidence: Airway exam: Mallampati III, TMD 5 cm, limited extension, mouth opening 3.5 cm (exam in the teaching case).
redFlags.implication: Difficult laryngoscopy, and succinylcholine is off the table.
redFlags.action: Video laryngoscope, bougie, SGA, difficult airway cart, rocuronium with sugammadex.

redFlags.implication: Must be known before an elective anesthetic.
redFlags.action: Urine hCG before any elective anesthetic.

redFlags.evidence: Nursing note; chipped molar on exam.
redFlags.action: Document and consent for dental injury risk.

planItems.item: Postpone; notify the surgeon and the patient
When rescheduled: trigger free TIVA, flushed machine with charcoal filters, dantrolene in the room

boothComplications.why: MH susceptible patient exposed to a trigger
